public_redistribution_allowlist_spec.policy_note: Separates the local research audit repository tree (which caches data/dossiers/*.json and frozen scenario-ranking JSONs locally for SHA-256 and character-offset verification) from the rights-aware public distribution package allowlist. Availability in PMC does not by itself grant bulk full-text redistribution rights for non-CC-BY articles; public export bundles exclude data/dossiers/*.json and frozen outward ranking files while retaining their SHA-256 verification digests in manifest.json, enforce a strict per-article aggregate verbatim quote ceiling (<=240 chars and <25% of abstract length) across all string fields for all studies lacking an explicit machine-verified CC-BY/CC0 license tag, and include all third-party database license notices (.licenses/*.txt), Layers 2-5 constructs/structures/atlases, and required raw queue/manifest inputs.
public_redistribution_allowlist_spec.cc_by_4_0_license_scope: Applies strictly to OpenIslet-authored structured annotations, coded arms, polarity registries, effect sizes, character-span offsets, SHA-256 digests, and cross-study graphs; third-party verbatim quotes are carved out in LICENSE and redacted above the 240-char / <25% per-article cap for all studies without an explicit CC-BY/CC0 license tag in --export-public-bundle.
public_redistribution_allowlist_spec.excerpt_ceiling_legal_note: 350-character per-effect quote ceiling (and <=240-character / <25%-abstract per-article aggregate ceiling in public bundles) is an internal repository design limit for factual attribution, not a claim of a universal statutory copyright safe harbor.

source_rights_and_redistribution_classif.extracted_study_json_excerpt_policy: Local audit tree: factual metadata + short verbatim evidence quotes (<=350 chars) + SHA-256 pointer to source dossier. Exported public bundle: all studies lacking a machine-verified CC-BY/CC0 license field are capped at <=240 aggregate verbatim chars (<25% of abstract) across all string fields with excess quotes replaced by [REDACTED_NON_OA_EXCERPT: see PMID + source_span + quote_sha256].

public_export_inventory_scope: Exact shipped relative file paths; manifest.json and .openislet_public_bundle marker are the only omitted self/marker files

public_arm_identifier_policy.scope: Deterministic opaque IDs; all exact foreign-key references transformed bijectively. Private source identifiers remain in the local audit tree.
